text:
Sam: Hey team — quick sync before the Zephyr Health POC kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT. High level goals I want aligned: 1) ingest clinical notes -> embeddings + rerank, 2) avg inference latency <250ms for the primary route, throughput target ~200 req/s, 3) quality gating: eval harness on ~500 prompts with pass thresholds. Any blockers? cc @Jordan @Mia @Lee_security

Jordan: Agree on goals. A few clarifying q's: what embedding vector dim and metric do they expect (cosine vs dot)? Will they call embeddings in batch or real‑time? Also they mentioned "de‑identified" data — need to confirm whether PHI might leak into test sets.

Lee_security: Heads up — healthcare customer. We'll require completed security questionnaire + CMEK option for keys if they pick Private. I'll share the minimal checklist (DLP, retention, CMEK, network controls). Also ask them about log retention window.

Mia: On pricing — customer asked about POC credits vs Dedicated pricing. My recommendation: 4‑week POC with a usage cap (credits) and a follow‑on committed Dedicated quote if they hit the agreed throughput. Sam, do you want me to draft a quick estimate for tomorrow? :thumbsup:

Sam: Yes please. I'll need expected token volumes to finalize. For success criteria we should make thresholds concrete. Proposal: 500 prompts split 60/40 clinical Q&A vs summarization. For Q&A use exact match + medical concept recall (target recall >0.85). For summarization propose ROUGE‑L >0.6 and human acceptability >=90%. Open to tweaks.

Alex_SE: Those thresholds sound reasonable. For clinical QA exact match is harsh; use a combined metric: EM + medical concept F1. We have the eval harness ready: `python eval_runner.py --dataset zephyr_500.json --model rdx-v1 --metrics em,concept_f1,rouge_l`

Jordan: Can we ask for a small sample of their notes before the call? If we can't get real samples, we'll produce synthetic prompts that mirror their schema. Timeline suggestion: kickoff day 0, initial eval run by day 7, iterate and tune by day 14, final demo by day 28. That gives time for retraining prompts and any model variant testing.

Terra_cust_success: I'll confirm the customer stakeholders. Current list: Priya (Product lead), Kumar (InfoSec), Diego (ML Eng). Need contact for network/peering if they want Private. I'll ping them and add to the calendar invite.

Sam: Action items: Jordan — draft prompt set + eval plan (due EOD today). Lee — send the security checklist + note about SOC2 addendum. Mia — prepare POC pricing/estimate. Terra — confirm customer stakeholders and get sample data contact. I will prepare the kickoff deck and facilitation. Everyone ok?

DeployBot: Reminder: if we need a demo/private env, file a GPU pool request in #eng-infra with tag `zephyr-poc`. Typical turnaround ~48h.

Lee_security: Also add: customer asked for IP protection language and data processor addendum. I'll loop legal for the appropriate DPA and SOC2 addendum.

Mia: Uploaded a draft pricing sheet (internal link): https://redwood.internal/sales/quotes/zephyr-poc (placeholder). Will update numbers once Sam confirms token estimate.

Sam: Perfect. For the kickoff call agenda I plan: intros (5m), goals & success criteria (10m), data & security (15m), eval plan + prompts (10m), timeline & next steps (5m). Start 10:00am PT. See everyone on the call. :rocket:
